articles.summary: The two biggest stories to come out of Saturday's college football Week 1 games involved the LSU Tigers and Michigan Wolverines.
articles.body:
The two biggest stories to come out of Saturday's college football Week 1 games involved the LSU Tigers and Michigan Wolverines.

LSU delivered a statement butt-kicking of the Clemson Tigers on home soil to kick off the Lane Kiffin era.

Michigan narrowly avoided defeat at home to the Western Michigan Broncos out of the MAC.

The most difficult decisions voters have to make for the Week 2 polls is where to properly place both programs.

LSU is deserving of a jump inside the top 10, while Michigan might be worthy of a drop from No. 16.

Lane Kiffin's LSU Tigers made the biggest statement among the ranked teams on Saturday.

The 11th-ranked Tigers blew out the Clemson Tigers in Baton Rouge, a result that will likely cause voters to move them up a few spots in the polls.

A jump into the top 10 is likely. LSU could follow a trend of big jumps from the preseason polls to Week 2 that was set last year.

LSU itself moved six spots and the Miami Hurricanes jumped five spots after their Week 1 victories a year ago.

A reshuffling of the deck is likely in the top 10 now that we've seen all of the teams on the field.

A leap into the top five isn't entirely out of the question since most of the teams in front of LSU played weaker opposition.

Regardless of where they land ahead of Week 2, LSU will have two opportunities to further move up the polls in September with SEC clashes against the Ole Miss Rebels and Texas A&M Aggies.

Will Michigan Drop Because of Poor Performance?

The Michigan Wolverines barely survived a potential upset bid from the Western Michigan Broncos on Saturday night.

The lackluster performance in Kyle Whittingham's debut as head coach will likely drop the Wolverines a spot or two in the rankings.

The results on Sunday and Monday could alter Michigan's position even more because the Louisville Cardinals have a chance to beat a top-10 team in Ole Miss and the SMU Mustangs have a chance to pick up a road ACC win.

The Washington Huskies, who sit right behind Michigan in the preseason AP poll, could impress on Sunday afternoon as well in their rivalry clash with the Washington State Cougars.

Michigan gave voters plenty of reasons drop it on its own, but that combined with other results could place the Wolverines on the bottom edge of the top 20 ahead of their Week 2 battle with the Oklahoma Sooners.

articles.title: Uno a uno del Barça vs Valencia: valoración y comentarios
articles.standfirst: Analizamos el rendimiento de los azulgranas y el planteamiento de Flick
articles.summary: Analizamos el rendimiento de los azulgranas y el planteamiento de Flick
articles.body: El Barcelona juega este mediodía en Mestalla con el objetivo de enlazar el cuarto triunfo consecutivo, afianzarse en el liderato y firmar una victoria que le refuerce de cara al estreno, el próximo miércoles, en la Champions League contra el Feyenoord. Precisamente, el exigente y apretado calendario provoca que Hansi Flick introduzca cambios en el once inicial: cuatro en relación al anterior cruce de LaLiga, que le midió contra el Rayo. Lamine Yamal es titular después de no ejercitarse ayer por un golpe y destaca también la titularidad de Rodri: es el primer compromiso en el que sale de inicio, tras disfrutar de algunos minutos frente al Athletic y el Rayo. Flick le quiere rodado para la Champions. Primera mitad: El meta catalán ambiciona esta tarde dejar su puerta a cero después de que el Rayo rompiera su imbatibilidad. Sus registros, no obstante, son destacados: ha encajado dos goles en los tres primeros partidos. En el minuto 2, sale para salvar un balón tras una pérdida de Cubarsí ante una aproximación de Danjuma. Y en el tiempo añadido resuelve con un paradón un uno a uno contra el delantero del Valencia. Nota al descanso: 7. Primera mitad: El polivalente jugador catalán, elegido esta semana por sus compañeros como el tercer capitán, regresa al once tras descansar en el último encuentro. Juega en Mestalla su tercer encuentro como lateral derecho, posición en la que será protagonista este curso. Buena combinación con Lamine. Se incorpora al ataque casi como un extremo. En el minuto 27, pide el cambio tras recibir un golpe en la nariz por un cabezazo de Rodri. Nota al descanso: 6. Primera mitad: El internacional se mantiene en el bloque titular. Encadena su tercer partido de inicio: descansó en el primero porque se incorporó más tarde tras disputar el Mundial. Su presencia en el once es indiscutible para Flick. Exigido por Donjuma. Una pérdida de balón suya provoca que Joan se luzca en una salida nada más comenzar el cruce. Pero está impecable en el resto de acciones. Ve la amarilla en su intento de evitar que el neerlandés encarara la portería culé. Nota al descanso: 7. Primera parte: El central catalán vuelve al once, ya que Flick apostó el pasado lunes por Christensen. El ex del Cornellà está llamado a ser el titular en el eje junto a Cubarsí. Comete un error, deja pasar un balón que acecha Otorbi, que su compañero en el eje resuelve con solvencia. Nota al descanso: 6. Primera mitad: El canterano, de 19 años, es la gran sorpresa de este inicio de temporada azulgrana. Asentado en el once, pese a la disponibilidad de Balde y Cancelo, juega, de nuevo, en el lateral zurdo. Muestra proyección ofensiva: en Mestalla adelanta metros en cuanto puede. Desenvuelto. Nota al descanso: 6,5. Primera mitad: El internacional canario, elegido por Flick como el segundo capitán del vestuario, es indiscutible. Es quien impone el criterio y el orden en el juego culé. Abre el campo. Activa rápido a sus compañeros para que salgan al contragolpe o estiren sus líneas. Y todo esto, sin dejar de presionar al rival cuando tiene el esférico. Nota al descanso: 7. Primera mitad: El centrocampista madrileño juega hoy su primer encuentro como titular tras disfrutar de algunos minutos contra el Athletic y el Rayo. Está llamado a ser importante, por calidad y liderazgo. Conecta bien con Lamine Yamal. Auxilia a la defensa. Muy atento en la recuperación. Autoritario. Su lucha provoca que en salto le dé un cabezazo a Eric en el tabique nasal y el catalán debe ser sustituido. Nota al descanso: 7. Segunda mitad: en el minuto dos ve amarilla por una falta sobre Aliou Dieng. Primera mitad: El centrocampista andaluz regresa al once tras descansar de inicio contra el Rayo. Se mueve cómodo y con éxito en la mediapunta. Goleador y asistente. Bonito pase final, picado, a Lamine Yamal en el tanto del extremo. Y marca con un gran disparo cruzado. Ya suma ¡4! en este arranque. Ambicioso. Certero. Nota al descanso: 8. Segunda mitad: menudo inicio de torneo. Le da la asistencia de gol a Raphinha. Primera mitad: El extremo internacional, quinto capitán, era la gran duda del once porque ayer sábado no se ejercitó por un golpe. El banquillo no es para él. En el minuto cinco, supera a Dimitrievski, con una vaselina con la izquierda, después de una asistencia de Fermín. Ni rastro de la contusión. No deja de poner en aprietos al meta del Valencia. Nota al descanso: 8. Segunda mitad: Generoso. Regala balones a Gordon, Raphinha... Primera mitad: El internacional inglés encadena la tercera titularidad. Juega de extremo izquierdo, posición 'vacante' desde que Raphinha juega de falso 9. Maffeo le marca con agresividad, pero logra escabullirse. Rápido. Ágil en el desmarque. Le da la asistencia a Fermín. Nota al descanso: 7. Primera mitad: El internacional brasileño vive el mejor momento de su carrera. Encadena tres partidos marcando y es el Pichichi con cinco goles. Flick, que le escogió como primer capitán, le eligió para ocupar el puesto de falso 9 y está brillando en esa demarcación. Obsesionado con el gol e incansable en la intensidad y el sacrificio defensivo. Se mueve por todo el campo sin olvidar la meta de Dimitrievski. Nota al descanso: 6. Segunda mitad: No habían pasado ni cinco minutos cuando superó al meta del Valencia, con la izquierda. ¡Cuarto partido viendo puerta! Primera mitad: El zaguero francés entra en el minuto 27 por el lesionado Eric. Ocupa el lateral derecho. Atento. Nota al descanso: 6. Primera mitad: El técnico alemán introduce cuatro cambios en la alineación en relación al encuentro contra el Rayo, pero es un once competitivo para intentar afianzarse en el liderato. Lamine se recupera del golpe que le impidió entrenarse ayer y Rodri se estrena de titular. Nota al descanso: 7.

articles.title: Jamie Vardy: Burnley sign former England and Leicester striker
articles.summary: Former Leicester City and England striker Jamie Vardy joins Burnley until the end of the season.
articles.body:
Former Leicester City and England striker Jamie Vardy has joined Burnley until the end of the season.

The 39-year-old, who is Leicester's record Premier League scorer with 145 goals, departed for Cremonese in 2025.

Vardy left the Italian side in the summer and now joins the winless Clarets who are bottom of the Championship.

"This club has a proper footballing history and passionate fans who deserve a team that represents them and their town," Vardy told the club website. , external

"I can't wait to get going on the pitch and help the team move in the right direction."

Vardy, who won 26 caps for England, scoring seven goals, spent 13 years at Leicester after signing from non-league Fleetwood Town in 2012.

He went on to score 200 goals in all competitions in 500 appearances.

Burnley, relegated from the Premier League last season, have made a poor start back in the second tier and have not won in five matches under new boss Nicky Hayen.

On Saturday they conceded two goals in the final 10 minutes to lose 2-1 at home to Bristol City.

"His experience and leadership will be invaluable to our squad, and we believe he can make a significant impact on our campaign," Hayen added.

"Jamie has a proven track record, and we are looking forward to seeing him in a Claret shirt."

articles.title: El Eibar muestra sus armas
articles.standfirst: Derrota al Granada, encadena tres victorias y acabará la jornada en zona de ascenso directo
articles.summary: Derrota al Granada, encadena tres victorias y acabará la jornada en zona de ascenso directo
articles.body: Nadie cuenta con el Eibar para el ascenso, pero ha comenzado el curso al mismo nivel que terminó la temporada pasada, en la que sumó 46 puntos en la segunda vuelta. Y eso son palabras mayores. 9 puntos de 12 posibles y un liderato provisional que no deja de ser anecdótico por mucho que ilusione a la parroquia armera. Iván Gil, Adu Ares y Guruzeta fueron los autores del incontestable triunfo del equipo de Jokin Aranbarri ante un Granada que cosechó el primer traspiés del curso. La puesta en escena armera fue sobresaliente. En los primeros cinco minutos ya se había plantado dos veces delante de Lizoain. Un pase magistral de Iván Gil dejó solo a Bautista delante del guardameta, que adivinó sus intenciones. Poco después, una pérdida del Granada en la salida acabó con un pase del 9 sobre Adu Ares que tampoco aprovechó. A la tercera, en la jugada más complicada, fue la vencida. Iván Gil sacó su talento a relucir para marcar con un disparo desde fuera del área y agarrar la batuta del ataque eibarrés. Los de Pacheta no terminaron de aterrizar en el partido. Hace meses que este Eibar es un rival muy difícil de meter mano cuando se adelanta. Se ha llevado la victoria las últimas 16 veces que ha comenzado ganando. El Granada fue víctima de la consistencia armera en una primera mitad en la que apenas generó peligro. Cada pérdida nazarí suponía peligro sobre la meta de Lizoain. El Eibar gobernaba el partido con y sin balón. Así, amplió diferencias antes del descanso con una genialidad de Adu Ares. Lejos de levantar el pie del acelerador, el cuadro local siguió a lo suyo tras el descanso. Pacheta introdujo dos sustituciones (Pascual y Marqués), pero no encontró el cambio de timón que buscaba. De hecho, Bautista y Guruzeta rozaron el tercero en el inicio de la segunda parte. Era cuestión de tiempo que llegara el gol de la sentencia y el encargado de hacerlo fue Guruzeta. El 10 se reencontró con el gol después de un año de sequía tras una gran incursión por la derecha de Álvaro. Ni la expulsión de Jair en la recta final, tras una entrada temeraria sobre Rodelas, puso en peligro el plácido triunfo de los armeros. Ipurua sigue en estado de felicidad y Aranbarri mantiene las señas de identidad que convirtieron a los armeros en uno de los equipos más completos de la categoría en los últimos meses del pasado curso. Al Granada no le queda otra que pasar página y aprender de lo sucedido.

articles.title: Arsenal - Chelsea en directo | Última hora de la Premier League hoy, en vivo
articles.summary: Le ha cogido el gusto el Chelsea a eso de marcar pronto. En la jornada 1 ante el Fulham marcó también en el primer minuto, y en la segunda fecha contr
articles.body:
Última hora del Arsenal - Chelsea en directo

¡¡¡Muuuuy buenas tardes y bienvenidos a todos y todas a una nueva jornada de la Premier League !!! ¡Bienvenidos a un nuevo partido del vigente campeón de Inglaterra , de nuevo, en el Emirates Stadium ! Partido por todo lo alto en el templo del equipo ' gunner ' con un gran aliciente en los dos banquillos. El Arsenal de Mikel Arteta recibe al Chelsea de Xabi Alonso en esta tercera fecha de la liga inglesa .

En un comienzo convincente para ambos, los dos equipos de Londres llegan a este enfrentamiento con la posibilidad de ponerse líder de la tabla. Eso sí, de una manera completamente distinta. El contraste entre conjuntos es muy grande. El Arsenal llega con 4 goles a favor y 0 en contra , en una muestra clara de lo que ha venido siendo el bloque de Arteta estas últimas temporadas. El nuevo Chelsea de Xabi Alonso , en cambio, ha arrancado este nuevo ciclo con dos partidos alocados y muchos goles en las dos porterías. Un triunfo por 2-3 ante el Fulham de Arbeloa y otro por 4-3 contra el Brighton en Stamford Bridge .

El partido también tendrá el duelo en los banquillos. En una Premier League con cada vez más entrenadores españoles , dos de ellos ocupan dos de los banquillos más importantes de Inglaterra ; y con un denominador común: gipuzcoanos y formados en la Real Sociedad . Arteta ya consiguió coronar su proyecto con el campeonato conseguido la temporada pasada, y Xabi Alonso ha llegado al conjunto azul de Londres para volver a hacer un Chelsea campeón.

Veremos qué nos depara este partidazo, uno de los mejores que se pueden ver esta campaña en un nuevo derbi de Londres y que últimamente ha tenido al Arsenal como claro vencedor. Desde agosto de 2021 que no vence el Chelsea a los de Mikel Arteta . Estaremos atentos a todo ello, desde las 17.30h , como siempre, aquí, en MARCA .

articles.title: Women's Super League round-up: Lisa Baum shines on Arsenal debut to beat Brighton and Tottenham dominate West Ham
articles.summary: Lisa Baum shined on her Arsenal debut and scored the only goal in the 1-0 win against Brighton; Tottenham beat West Ham 3-1 and Kirsty Hanson scored twice while making also making her debut for the club
articles.body:
Baum scores on debut to secure narrow Arsenal win

Nineteen-year-old winger Lisa Baum scored on her Arsenal debut to secure a 1-0 win at Brighton.

The winger introduced herself in emphatic fashion after dancing around defenders and firing her shot into the top left corner to break the deadlock in the 10th minute.

The new-look Arsenal side - featuring new signings Misa, Georgia Stanway and Ona Battle - came close to doubling the lead but were short of their usual standards in front of goal to start the new season.

Alessia Russo and Stina Blackstenius both came close but squandered opportunities from close range.

Renee Slegers' side were then forced to rely on a confident defensive performance to keep Brighton at bay but Arturo Ruiz will take positives from a spirited performance in his first game in charge despite the result.

Spurs dominate West Ham as debutant Hanson shines

Tottenham started their WSL in convincing fashion with a comfortable 3-1 victory over West Ham United.

The Hammers made 10 signings during the summer transfer window, four of whom started at Brisbane Road, but the visitors struggled to gel as Spurs controlled the tempo with an impressive level of intensity and the added bit of quality.

Kirsty Hanson was the star of the show on her Spurs debut, scoring twice, including an incredible curling effort from outside the 18-yard box.

It was Signe Gaupset who got things started though, reacting quickest to a loose ball finding the net via the inside of the post with a smart finish on the bounce. She then turned provider for Hanson's first, running from beyond the halfway line before sliding the Scot in to apply the finishing touch.

Spurs had plenty of chances to extend their lead in the second half, with Cathinka Tandberg and Julie Blakstad missing the pick of the opportunities.

They did finally get a third as Hanson one-upped herself with her second of the afternoon. Receiving the ball on the edge of the box, the winger wasn't closed down and was allowed to open up her body and find the far top corner beyond a stranded Constance Picaud.

Viviane Asseyi grabbed a stoppage-time consolation to provide something for the visitors to cheer, but it mattered little. Martin Ho's side repeated the same result as they managed on the opening day against the Hammers last season, but in even more convincing fashion.

Defending champs City get off to winning start - but it wasn't perfect

Manchester City's slow start to the game was quickly rectified in the second half as goals from Mary Fowler and Khadija Shaw secured a 2-0 win against Birmingham City to begin their WSL title defence.

City were left frustrated by the promoted side in the first half until Fowler's low shot found the bottom right corner to break the deadlock in the 49th minute.

Shaw would rise highest to meet Kerstin Casparij's corner six minutes later to score her first of the afternoon.

Beth Mead made her debut for the club off the bench and was the provider for the pick of the goals as Shaw glanced home a second header of the day to add a third.

Jade Rose's error at the back after being caught on the ball in spectacular fashion to allow a late consolation goal for Oceane Hurtre marked the only blemish on what was a strong start to the season for the champions.

Liverpool give Charlton rude welcome to top flight in thrashing

It took Liverpool 13 games to win their first WSL match last season, but there was no such wait this time around as they thumped promoted Charlton 4-0 in their season's opener.

Grace Fisk will steal the headlines, with the central defender grabbing the first two goals to put the Reds on course for victory, but debutant Vivien Endemann was the standout for the visitors on her debut.

Fisk opened the scoring inside eight minutes with a tap-in on the line, but her second couldn't have been more different. After Endemann's cut-back managed to evade everyone in the area, the Liverpool skipper met it on the edge of the box with an inch perfect strike into the top corner.

Endemann then got the goal she thoroughly deserved with a thunderous drive just after the hour mark, with Cornelia Kapocs rounding things off with a stoppage-time penalty.

Charlton never really looked like threatening as the scoreline suggests, but Gareth Taylor's Liverpool end the opening weekend top of the league.

Crystal Palace became the only promoted side to pick up all three points on the opening weekend thanks to a 1-0 win over Everton.

Returning to the top flight after just a year in WSL 2, the Eagles issued a statement of intent as Lexi Lloyd-Smith notched the only goal of the game on her debut in the 34th minute.

Things could have been better for Lloyd-Smith had her second not been ruled out for offside. But in the end Palace were able to hold on despite late pressure from the visitors to take victory.

articles.title: Kiat Lim llega a Mestalla camuflado en el autocar del Valencia en una tarde de protestas contra la propiedad
articles.standfirst: El presidente blanquinegro presencia su primer partido del equipo en un momento crítico
articles.summary: El presidente presencia su primer partido del equipo en un momento crítico
articles.body: El presidente del Valencia, Kiat Lim, llegó a Mestalla camuflado en el autobús de concentración del primer equipo, acompañado por el CEO de Fútbol, Ron Gourlay, y por el director general del club, Javier Solís, para presenciar el encuentro frente al Barcelona, el primer partido oficial de Liga que sigue en Mestalla desde que fue nombrado máximo mandatario de la entidad en marzo de 2025. La presencia de Kiat Lim se produce en uno de los momentos más delicados de los últimos años para la entidad valencianista. Horas antes del encuentro, el dirigente aterrizó en el aeropuerto de Manises en un vuelo privado y se desplazó al hotel de concentración del equipo, donde mantuvo contacto con la expedición valencianista antes de dirigirse a Mestalla junto a los futbolistas. Aunque el hijo de Peter Lim ya había ocupado el palco presidencial durante el Trofeo Naranja disputado el pasado mes de agosto frente al Newcastle, el choque ante el Barcelona suponía su estreno en un partido de Liga en Mestalla como presidente del club. En aquella anterior visita ya pudo escuchar de primera mano los cánticos de protesta dirigidos contra la propiedad del Valencia. La visita de Kiat Lim coincide con un contexto de fuerte crítica social por parte del valencianismo. El arranque liguero del equipo de Carlos Corberán, que llegaba al encuentro con sólo un punto sumado en las tres primeras jornadas y situado en la zona baja de la clasificación, ha incrementado la preocupación de la afición. A la inquietud deportiva se ha sumado el descontento generado por el mercado de fichajes, considerado deficiente por amplios sectores del valencianismo. Diversos colectivos de aficionados interpretan que la plantilla no ha sido reforzada al nivel necesario para competir con mayores garantías durante la temporada. Las explicaciones ofrecidas esta semana por Ron Gourlay sobre la planificación deportiva tampoco contribuyeron a rebajar la tensión. Tras su comparecencia pública para analizar el mercado, organizaciones como Libertad VCF, el Col·lectiu de Penyes Valencianistes y la Curva Nord impulsaron nuevas acciones de protesta contra la gestión de Meriton Holdings y de Peter Lim como máximo accionista de la entidad. En la previa del Valencia-Barcelona se convocaron concentraciones de protesta en los aledaños del estadio para expresar el rechazo a la gestión de la propiedad. Además, la Curva Nord promovió una medida para retrasar su entrada al estadio hasta el minuto 19 de partido, iniciativa que recibió el respaldo de otros colectivos y de aficionados a través de las redes sociales. El objetivo de estas movilizaciones es visibilizar el descontento existente con la dirección del club y enviar un mensaje de rechazo a la gestión que, a juicio de los sectores críticos, ha contribuido al deterioro deportivo e institucional del Valencia durante los últimos años.

articles.title: Division III power Mount Union loses in Week 1 to snap 85-game regular-season win streak that dated back to 2016
articles.summary: The loss was also Mount Union's first Week 1 loss since 1987.
articles.body:
Division III powerhouse Mount Union lost its first regular-season game since 2016 on Saturday.

The Purple Raiders fell 24-23 to Wheaton in their 2026 season-opener after Wheaton blocked a game-tying extra point with 22 seconds to go. Mount Union's Kayden Minner scored on a 1-yard run ahead of the failed extra point, and the Purple Raiders elected to go for the tie and potential overtime instead of what could have been a game-winning two-point conversion.

After blocking the PAT, Wheaton then recovered Mount Union's onside kick.

The loss snapped a regular-season win streak that lasted 85 games. Before Saturday, the last time Mount Union lost a non-playoff game was on Nov. 12, 2016, when John Carroll scored a 31-28 win. Most of the members of that Mount Union team are now in their 30s.

Mount Union made the semifinals of the D3 playoffs that season and won the 2017 national title with a 15-0 season. Since then, the team has, remarkably, not won a national championship as the regular-season win streak lived on. Over the past six full seasons, Mount Union has lost the Stagg Bowl three times and was eliminated in the third round of the Division III playoffs in 2025 after an 11-0 start.

Saturday's loss was also the first time Mount Union had lost a Week 1 game in 39 years. Until 2026, the team's most recent season-opening loss came in a 17-15 defeat to Wooster in 1987.

articles.summary: Dos empates (ayer contra el Mallorca) y dos derrotas, balance hasta ahora de los alicantinos, recién ascendidos a Segunda

Y todo después de que su equipo, recién ascendido, haya sumado dos empates (ayer contra el Mallorca, que el curso pasado era de Primera) y dos derrotas en este estreno de curso. En un comunicado del club en la tarde de este domingo, el conjunto alicantino agradecía a Claudio el trabajo, compromiso y dedicación durante el tiempo que el técnico valenciano ha dirigido la nave alicantina. Cogió al equipo la pasada temporada, en Primera RFEF, y lo devolvió al fútbol profesional por la vía rápida. El nuevo proyecto en Segunda arrancaba de su mano, aunque por momentos hubo dudas sobre su continuidad. Finalmente, el club apuesta por cerrar su etapa en el banquillo. De momento, la plantilla queda a cargo de Josep Ferrando, técnico que ejercía funciones de segunda entrenador, a expensas de encontrar y dar con la tecla del nuevo entrenador que engrase la friolera cifra de fichajes cerrados por el equipo de Elda en el mercado de verano.

articles.standfirst: Nacho Palencia apunta en Marcador a una posible salida del técnico argentino al término de la temporada y señala que la decisión dependería principalmente del propio Simeone
articles.summary: Nacho Palencia apunta en Marcador a una posible salida del técnico argentino al término de la temporada y señala que la decisión dependería principalmente del propio Simeone
articles.body: La continuidad de Diego Pablo Simeone en el Atlético de Madrid vuelve a generar dudas. Nacho Palencia, invitado este domingo en Marcador de Radio MARCA, junto a Pablo Parra y Carlos Pozuelo, se mostró partidario de que existe una posibilidad considerable de que esta temporada sea la última del técnico argentino al frente del conjunto rojiblanco. "Ahora mismo me decantaría porque es en un 50-60% que es el último año de Simeone en el Atlético de Madrid", aseguró Palencia durante el programa. Matizó que la continuidad del entrenador dependerá en buena medida de lo que ocurra durante la temporada, aunque dejó claro que no lo ve tanto como una decisión del club, sino como una posible decisión del propio Simeone. Palencia recordó que Simeone tiene contrato con el Atlético hasta 2027 y que, para continuar más allá de esa fecha, debería comenzar a negociar una renovación. En ese sentido, puso el foco en el nuevo escenario institucional del club, con el grupo Apollo como nuevo propietario y Mateu Alemany como una de las figuras de peso en la estructura deportiva. El futuro del técnico vuelve así a quedar en el centro del debate, después de más de 14 años al frente del Atlético. Aunque la posibilidad de una salida todavía está lejos de ser una certeza, las palabras de Palencia abren la puerta a que el ciclo del 'Cholo' pueda estar acercándose a su final.

articles.title: Gol y asistencia de Jacobo Ortega para liderar la brutal remontada del Estrasburgo
articles.standfirst: El ex del Real Madrid se estrenó como goleador en la Ligue 1
articles.summary: El ex del Real Madrid se estrenó como goleador en la Ligue 1
articles.body: Jacobo Ortega (Madrid, 2006) ya sabe lo que es marcar en la Ligue 1. El excanterano del Real Madrid, traspasado a cambio de 10 millones de euros, ha liderado la remontada del Estrasburgo (2-6) frente al Troyes con un gol... y una asistencia. La tarde, sin embargo, comenzó torcida. Antoine Mille adelantó al Troyes en el 9' al rematar con la zurda un centro de Anis Ouzenadji tras un buen pase filtrado por Hugo Picard. En el 40', poco antes del descanso, Jacobo -titular por segunda jornada consecutiva- acudió al rescate. Sebastian Nanasi inició la jugada con un gran cambio de juego y Gessime Yassine sirvió el 'pase de la muerte' para que el ex del Real Madrid, con la diestra, se estrenara como goleador con el Estrasburgo. La pasada temporada, entre el Castilla, el Real Madrid C y el juvenil, marcó 18 dianas en 56 encuentros. Rubricó la remontada Diogo Sousa en el 42'. El ex del Vitória Guimaraes cazó un 'balón muerto' en el área y marcó... a la segunda. Patrick Beach sacó su primer remate a bocajarro, con la diestra, y, acto seguido, anotó a placer, con la zurda. Jacobo Ortega volvió a apacerer en el 57' para poner tierra de por medio. Esta vez, disfrazado de asistente. El atacante español cedió para que Giovanni Reyna marcara desde la frontal tras una rápida combinación entre Yassine -gran partido el suyo-, Diogo Sousa y el propio Jacobo. Con la victoria en el bolsillo, en el 71', Hugo Oliveira optó por sustituir a Jacobo Ortega para dar entrada a Conrad Harder. Hubo tiempo, sin embargo, para que Samuel Amo-Ameyaw se luciera. El ex del Southampton marcó el 1-4 en el 85'. Recibió de Dário Essugo y se acomodó el balón a la zurda para marcar con un tiro al palo largo. El quinto, en el 87', fue mejor si cabe. Interceptó el saque de Beach y se sacó a tres rivales de encima, siempre tirando la diagonal hacia el medio, antes de fusilar con la zurda. Quedaba tiempo, aún, para otro gol más del Estrasburgo. A la contra. Diogo Sousa dejó a Harder mano a mano y el ex de Sporting CP y RB Leipzig no perdonó en el 93'. Con el tiempo ya casi cumplido, en el 95', Jérémy Le Douaron maquilló el resultado al rematar sobre la línea un centro de Kandet Diawara.

articles.title: Un descomunal gol de Maitland-Niles en la última jugada del partido evita el triunfo del Manchester United
articles.standfirst: Los de Carrick pierden dos puntos en el 95'
articles.summary: Los de Carrick pierden dos puntos en el 95'
articles.body: Un final de película. Ainsley Maitland-Niles se inventó en la última jugada del partido un disparo desde fuera del área que entró por la escuadra de la portería que defendía Lammens. Así arruinó el ex del Arsenal la posible victoria del Manchester United en su visita al estadio del Everton. Todo pasó en una segunda parte en la que, dicho sea, el Everton no mereció perder. Fueron los 'Red Devils' los que golpearon primero con un buen tanto de Mbeumo tras un eslalon que culminó con un disparo al palo largo. El United se defendía bien ante el empuje local y parecía que, por qué no, iba a sumar su segunda victoria consecutiva en Premier. Pero, como en el debut ante el Hull (derrota), volvieron a 'pinchar'. Y eso que en el 88' iban ganando 1-2 gracias a un gol de cabeza de Sesko que había 'anulado' el empate de Tyrique George. Pero en el 95' explotó todo en el nuevo Hill Dickinson Stadium. Maitland-Niles se inventó un golazo en la última jugada del partido tras cazar un rechace y disparar desde fuera del área. Nada pudo hacer Lammens. Los de Carrick, que se lamentaba en la banda, se quedan con apenas cuatro puntos tras tres jornadas.

articles.title: Embattled FIFA President Gianni Infantino to stand for re-election
articles.summary: FIFA says its chief has not changed his stance on re-election as Infantino faces widespread criticism.
articles.body:
Amid widespread criticism of his leadership and the growing threat of legal proceedings, FIFA President Gianni Infantino has confirmed his intention to run for re-election in six months’ time, football’s global governing body said.

Infantino has not changed his plans to “stand for re-election in 2027”, a FIFA spokesperson said in a statement on Sunday, hours after the FIFA chief avoided questions on his future at the Under-20 Women’s World Cup in Poland.

“The FIFA president announced in April that he will stand for re-election in 2027. Of course, nothing has changed. Mr Infantino will be standing for re-election,” the statement said.

On Saturday, the 56-year-old stayed silent on the leadership challenge he faces as a result of his failed plan to sell rights to private investors in the World Cup, and declined to answer questions about his re-election upon arrival at the opening match of the tournament.

Infantino was in the stands speaking with Polish Football Federation President Cezary Kulesza as hosts Poland faced Argentina at the Arena Katowice.

“There will be a lot to say, but there will be a right place and a right time to say this. It’s not today, it’s not here, but here and today, we are enjoying football,” Infantino told British broadcaster Sky News outside the stadium.

“We are continuing at FIFA, of course, to work to give every corner of the world a chance, an opportunity, a dignity, to find ways and means for them to become better and to participate and to celebrate football, which we all love.”

Infantino did not answer when asked if he had considered resigning or whether he still intends to stand for a fourth term next year.

The Swiss-Italian has been the most powerful man in world football over the past 10 years, but has increasingly lost support from regional football confederations and national associations. Last month, he appeared to be pulling out all the stops in a bid to retain his position, despite growing calls for his ousting and wide-ranging disapproval of his plans.

He is seen as a divisive figure in international football , with his close ties to some of the most powerful global leaders and plans for maximising revenue from football viewed as a threat to the game.

With a little over six months until the next round of elections for FIFA’s presidency, Infantino appears to be losing ground among his usual backers.

FIFA presidents are limited to three terms in office, with each term lasting four years.

However, in 2022, Infantino successfully argued that his first spell in charge, which began when he was elected at an extraordinary FIFA Congress in 2016 following Sepp Blatter’s resignation, should not count towards that limit because it completed an interrupted mandate.

His plans to run for a fourth term have been questioned by critics and rights groups, who have asked FIFA’s Governance, Audit and Compliance Committee (GACC) to block the re-election bid.

Infantino’s support has waned, especially since making no secret of his close ties with United States President Donald Trump and announcing FIFA’s plans to privatise the World Cup in order to maximise revenue from the tournament.

He was the target of widespread scathing criticism in December, when he handed the inaugural FIFA Peace Prize to Trump at the FIFA World Cup 2026 draw in Washington, DC.

A further blow to the global football chief’s position came in the days after the World Cup, when he invited private investors to buy a stake in future profits from World Cups and all FIFA events. The investor group was led by Joshua Kushner , the American businessman who is also the younger brother of Trump’s son-in-law, Jared Kushner.

Last month, UEFA asked a federal court in the US for permission to obtain testimony and documents from FIFA entities in Florida for use in a planned criminal complaint in Switzerland against Infantino, according to a court filing.

In an urgent application filed under US law, European football’s governing body said it was considering criminal proceedings against Infantino and potentially other FIFA officials and advisers. That was over their now-abandoned plan to transfer commercial rights linked to men’s and women’s World Cups and the Club World Cup into a new subsidiary called FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE).

In turn, FIFA accused UEFA of a “smear campaign” and a “fishing expedition” and hit back by asking US judges for permission to contest the UEFA requests.

“While these applications are styled as legal pleadings with captions and docket numbers, they are little more than press releases in further support of UEFA’s smear campaign against FIFA and its leadership,” said the FIFA filings.

They say UEFA does not have the right to demand FIFA internal documents because no criminal proceedings yet exist in Switzerland or elsewhere.

The polls to elect FIFA’s next president will be held at the global governing body’s next congress, scheduled for March 18, 2027 in Rabat, Morocco.

All challengers vying for the post must declare their candidacy by November 18 .

The candidates will face off in a poll involving all 211 FIFA member nations, with 106 votes required to pick a winner.

articles.title: Everton v Man Utd player ratings: Jack Grealish returns but which sub made the biggest impact?
articles.summary: How Everton and Manchester United's players rated at Hill Dickinson Stadium.
articles.body:
Ainsley Maitland-Niles crashed home a thunderous long-range shot as Everton scored in stoppage time to earn a 2-2 draw at home to Manchester United .

Here's how I rated the players and you can see how you scored them below.

What do BBC Sport's player ratings mean?

Maitland-Niles stunner earns Everton point against Man Utd

Jordan Pickford: Not the busiest afternoon for the England keeper - might have done better for the goal. 6

Merlin Rohl (off 74, Hackney): Encouraged to get forward more by team-mates but seemed wary of leaving too much space behind him. Did provide the cross that Thierno Barry should have headed in. 6

James Tarkowski: Long ball straight to Senne Lammens in the second half drew groans from the crowd and a stream of invective from his manager. 6

Jarrad Branthwaite: Strong defensive performance, not afraid to get his body in the way of Man Utd shots and a brilliant tackle on Rashford. Found time to have a go at goal himself at the other end. 8

Vitalii Mykolenko: Found himself in space to create something inside the Man Utd box but failed to make the most of the opportunity. Got behind Bryan Mbeumo at the start of the second but again the outcome was poor. 6

Harrison Armstrong: Cautioned for needlessly dragging Bruno Fernandes round the neck, but a minor blot on an otherwise impressive performance. Easy to see why the Everton fans reacted so fiercely to the prospect of him being sold. 7

James Garner (off 76, Maitland-Niles): Decent effort against his old club. Worked tirelessly in defence and going forward. 7

Brennan Johnson (off 66, Grealish): Picked ahead of Jack Grealish but not the greatest game going forward. Blatant foul on Matheus Cunha earned a booking but probably worth it as it stopped the Brazilian racing into the box. 6

Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall: Industrious performance in the middle of the pitch went unrewarded in terms of result but would have been appreciated by boss David Moyes. 7

Tyrique George: Started well and lifted the ball over Mbeumo with superb skill. Drifted out of the game in the second half, until he beat Lammens. 6

Thierno Barry: Lucky not to be booked for a clear dive early on to try and win a penalty. Headed Everton 's best first-half opportunity over from close range. Overhit a pass that could have sent Johnson through. 5

Jack Grealish (on 66): Ran at Diogo Dalot and drew a yellow card from the Man Utd man. Clearly determined to make an impact. His presence roused Everton 's fans for a big finish. Tied Mbeumo in knots as he tried to set up an equaliser. 7

Hayden Hackney (on 75): Played the pass for the equaliser. 6

Ainsley Maitland-Niles (on 77): The decisive contribution. 8

Subs not used: Mark Travers, Michael Keane, Jake O'Brien, Tyler Dibling, Charly Alcaraz, Braiden Graham.

Senne Lammens: Made a mess of a routine ball into the box, although he had been impeded by Dewsbury-Hall. Aside from that, usual unflappable self. Saved the shots you would expect. 6

Diogo Dalot (off 84, Yoro): Another fortunate to escape an early yellow card for hauling back Tyrique George. Solid after that though and strong in the tackle. 6

Harry Maguire: Needed treatment for a bloody nose in the opening minutes but recovered and produced usual calm display. Partnership with Lisandro Martinez very effective. 6

Lisandro Martinez: Excellent effort from the Argentina defender. Positioning superb and didn't dive in for rash challenges. Got in the way of a Johnson shot as Everton pressed for an equaliser. 8

Luke Shaw (off 91, Mazraoui): Excellent effort and his fitness is so crucial now for Michael Carrick. Good block to stop an Armstrong effort and nipped in as Johnson was about to shoot. 8

Kobbie Mainoo (off 84, Santos): The usual smooth display, taking the ball and moving it on. Precise cross-field pass to Mbeumo led to the opener. 7

Youri Tielemans: Long-range effort didn't cause Pickford any problems. Went about his business quietly but still to see a stand-out performance. 6

Bryan Mbeumo: Quiet first half when a lot of his best work was in defence. Brilliant goal at the start of the second though. 8

Bruno Fernandes: Volleyed against the bar from a Mbuemo nod back, had another first-half effort deflected over and another blocked. 7

Marcus Rashford (off 70, Dorgu): Another eye-catching performance from the England man. Cunha wasted some of his excellent approach work. 8

Matheus Cunha (off 70, Sesko): Started in the number nine position and tried to exert influence but wasted an excellent chance midway through the first half. 6

Patrick Dorgu (on 70): Game went crazy after he came on. 6

Benjamin Sesko (on 70): Thought he had scored the winner here for the second season running. Needs to stay fit. 8

Subs not used: Karl Darlow, Mason Mount, Joshua Zirkzee, Ayden Heaven.

articles.title: FIFA president Gianni Infantino will stand for re-election in 2027 amid concerns over leadership
articles.summary: Infantino refused to answer questions about a possible resignation and surrounding controversies during the Women’s Under-20 World Cup in Poland.
articles.body:
Embattled FIFA president Gianni Infantino intends to stand for re-election for a fourth term amid significant controversy regarding his tenure.

"The FIFA President announced in April that he will stand for re-election in 2027," said a statement released by the organization, via the BBC . "Of course, nothing has changed. Mr. Infantino will be standing for re-election."

Infantino was asked by reporters at the Women's Under-20 World Cup in Poland if he intended to resign, but refused to answer questions on Saturday.

"There will be a lot to say, but there will be a right place and a right time," Infantino told Sky Sports . "It's not today, it's not here."

Calls for Infantino's resignation arose following his plans to sell stakes in FIFA competitions, including the men's and women's World Cup, to private investment firms, one of which is run by venture capitalist Josh Kushner. The project, ultimately abandoned , was known as FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE).

UEFA, the governing body of European football, is considering taking legal action against Infantino after pursuing legal action in August to undertake the discovery process in order to uncover information about the FFE. If actions viewed as "fradulent" are uncovered, UEFA could bring criminal charges against Infantino, in addition to other FIFA officials.

Among the allegations against Infantino is that investors were offered "absurdly low" stakes in the FFE venture. Under this arrangement, Kushner's venture capital firm Thrive Capital was going to pay $4.2 billion to FIFA for a 20% stake in a company set up to run commercial events such as the men's and women's World Cup.

From the UEFA legal application, via the BBC :

"Under the terms Infantino announced, those investors stood to acquire a permanent financial interest in Fifa's commercial arm for $4.2bn, implying an absurdly low enterprise value of only approximately $20bn, a figure that was neither the product of an open, competitive auction, nor tested by any independent valuer." […] "Infantino pushed the plan through internal FIFA approval only days earlier at a hastily convened meeting where a limited number of FIFA's management officials and employees — some of whom had never heard of the plan — were given mere hours to sign off on an unprecedented multi-billion dollar scheme."

"Infantino pushed the plan through internal FIFA approval only days earlier at a hastily convened meeting where a limited number of FIFA's management officials and employees — some of whom had never heard of the plan — were given mere hours to sign off on an unprecedented multi-billion dollar scheme."

Before the FFE proposal was scrapped, UEFA threatened to boycott FIFA competitions if it went through. CONCACAF, the governing body of football in North and Central America and the Caribbean, joined UEFA in rejecting the proposal, as did South America's CONMEBOL.

The Asian Football Confederation also protested, expressing "serious concerns" over matters extending "far beyond a single proposal," according to The Athletic .

UEFA has stated its intention to work with the other world soccer federations to find a candidate who can run against Infantino. Nominations must be submitted by Nov. 18.

Any candidate also running for the FIFA post must be backed by at least 106 of the 211 FIFA member associations, the BBC reports . Among the candidates being considered is CONCACAF president Victor Montagliani.

articles.title: ‘We knew that…’: Standout Everton star provides damning post-match Man Utd verdict, Carrick will be fuming
articles.summary: Despite leading twice against Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, the spoils were ultimately shared between Manchester United and the hosts.Michael Carric...
articles.body:
Despite leading twice against Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, the spoils were ultimately shared between Manchester United and the hosts.

Michael Carrick's men have now lost, won and drawn in their opening three Premier League fixtures.

Indeed, Bryan Mbeumo and Benjamin Sesko's best efforts were not enough for the Red Devils to head back to Manchester with all three points in the bag.

United were holding on to their 2-1 lead from the 88th minute, when Benjamin Sesko headed home from a stellar Luke Shaw cross, until the sixth minute of injury time.

That was when scrappy play inside the area resulted in Ainsley Maitland-Niles capitalising on a loose ball outside the box and firing a long-range strike past Senne Lammens.

Tyrique George had levelled for the Toffees the first time around, and while it was an outstanding finish on his part, questions will be asked of Senne Lammens, who was beaten at his near post.

Post-match, George provided a damning assessment of United's game plan, as he told Sky Sports that Everton still had faith they could get a result even when they were trailing.

"We knew that we could get back into the game," said the former Chelsea prospect. "That's what we did. [A] really strong performance."

It's safe to say that Carrick will be enraged over the fact that his team were unable to see out the win in the dying embers of the contest.

Next up is United's Champions League opener at home to Sabah on Thursday, September 10.

Then, it's the first Manchester derby instalment of 2026/2027, with Enzo Maresca's Manchester City making the short trip over to Old Trafford a week from today.

articles.title: Everton 2-2 Man Utd: Ainsley Maitland-Niles scores outrageous stoppage-time equaliser to earn dramatic draw
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as Man Utd twice led but fell to a late Ainsley Maitland-Niles leveller in a dramatic draw; all goals were scored in a pulsating second half of the game
articles.body:
Bryan Mbeumo and Benjamin Sesko were out to prove just how indispensable ruthless forwards are in the Premier League, scoring at the start and end of the second period to steer Man Utd to what looked likely to be their first away victory. Mbeumo's solo effort 61 seconds after the restart was of the highest order.

Everton, meanwhile, have been reduced to a strike-force of just one - Thierno Barry - following what Jamie Carragher called a "disastrous" transfer window. The 23-year-old accumulated more xG value than any other player on the pitch but failed to land a single effort on target. In the end, that did not matter.

Tyrique George responded with a stunner of his own, beating Senne Lammens with a vicious strike at his near post. And Maitland-Niles had the final say with a special goal after Sesko headed Man Utd ahead for the second time in the 88th minute.

Latest news and rumours: Everton | Man Utd

David Moyes' side might be light on strength in depth but his squad does not lack scorers. Both George and Maitland-Niles joined this summer and look to be inspired bits of business, with Jack Grealish's reintroduction in the second half also providing the spark the hosts lacked in the first.

Maitland-Niles is the first player to score on his Everton debut since Richarlison in August 2018. Timed at 95:11, his equaliser was the latest goal ever scored at the Hill Dickinson and means Man Utd have conceded twice in every league outing so far.
